answer: Each new agent locks a 500-token bond for ten epochs before its votes count, and peers check at every close that the bond is still there. A farm of 1,000 fakes ties up 500,000 tokens, and splitting funds across many wallets fails because each identity needs its own full bond. The bond works like basalt: heavy to move and impossible to fake. An honest agent, whether it sells willow furniture or audits code, posts it once and gets it back in full after the wait. Its voting weight reaches its zenith only when those ten epochs pass.
